div.div: Overview of the DiT-MoE architecture. Generally, DiT-MoE is built upon the DiT and composed of MoE-inserted Transformer blocks. In between, we replace the MLP with a sparsely activated mixture of MLPs. The right subfigure demonstrates the details of MoE layer integration of the shared expert strategy.
